## Bottom line

Positive control **inconclusive**: BJD 2458679.4425: partial, depth 154 ± 20 ppm (catalogue 178 ppm).
Outside the catalogued epoch the screen left 904 threshold entries forming **406 distinct event(s)**, **20 persistent** (SAP and PDCSAP, two or more baselines). None is vetted; see *Screen events*.

This is a pipeline check on a known object, not a discovery claim. No period is implied by a single transit.

## Reviewer notes (2026-09-25)

Positive control is **inconclusive/partial** at BJD 2458679.4425 in sector 13: measured 154 ± 20 ppm vs catalogue 178 ppm (171 usable cadences; entry offset +2.01 h). The 90%-completeness floor at k* = 2 is 1000 ppm for the tabulated 1–8-h durations, far above this 5.74-h, 178-ppm signal; no bounded null at catalogue depth follows.

The 20 persistent event rows cluster into five complexes:

| Sector / persistent BJD-like entries | Profile/health check | Reviewer assessment |
|---|---|---|
| S13: 2458657.05430, .10361, .43139, .86682 | low-amplitude, irregular 2–3-cadence features across one day; QUALITY=0, gaps 4–8 min; sampled centroids within ~1σ | repeated short crossings over a varying baseline, not discrete transit profiles |
| S27: 2459040.73295 | few-cadence feature with SAP/PDCSAP scatter-level bins; QUALITY=0, 2-min gap | noise/trend |
| S67: 2460150.46168 | profile truncated ~25 min after the event and shows only a soft offset; QUALITY=0, 2-min gap | edge/baseline artifact favored |
| S95: 2460900.06204/.38981 | two shallow entries ~7.9 h apart on a noisy, low-level baseline; QUALITY=0, gaps 4–8 min | no isolated transit shape |
| S101: 2461119.43471, .45068, .48124, .49582, .63611, .68402, .77639, .78959, .80000, .81389, .85139, .86320 | one ~10-h cluster of short entries; binned SAP/PDCSAP show low-level baseline structure rather than a coherent ingress/egress; QUALITY=0, gaps 4–6 min; centroid residuals <1σ | likely low-frequency variability/systematics, not 12 independent events |

The campaign has 904 threshold entries / 406 grouped events in these six products, but no repeat candidate. This bright (Tmag 7.30) target's catalogue signal is much shallower than the screen's calibrated floor. Prior-art cross-match answered all four services; no VSX variable match. Alternative detrending, pixel/difference-image and pointing audits remain untested.
